arabic.title: Arabic, without apology

foundations.title: Tokens, type and direction
foundations.intro: The Signal palette, the type scale and the component classes, rendered in both languages. This page is the reference for the layer the screens will be built on — it is not one of the eight screens.
foundations.notice: The eight product screens have no approved layouts yet. This build stops at the foundation on purpose.

color.title: Color
color.body: One accent voice on a deep petrol ground. Steps 700–900 for tinted fills and borders, 500 as the base, 100–300 for text on those tints. The accent is a line, a mark and a glow — never a flood.
color.contrastNote: Measured on the ground: text 14.8:1, accent 6.79:1, neutral-500 5.61:1. Neutral-600 is 3.45:1 — rules and borders only, never readable copy.

type.title: Typography
type.body: Inter for Latin, IBM Plex Sans Arabic for Arabic, IBM Plex Mono for code. One weight does the work: 500 for headings, 400 for body. Hierarchy is size and space, never a heavier weight.
type.headingSample: Career tracks built on real projects
type.bodySample: Each track ends with a repository a hiring manager can read. You get line-level review on every submission.
type.arabicNote: Arabic runs at 1.5 line-height minimum, and is never set in all-caps, letter-spaced, or condensed.

direction.title: Direction
direction.body: Direction is one attribute on the document. Layout CSS is written in logical properties, so the whole page mirrors without a second stylesheet. What does not mirror is content: numbers, code, repo paths, diffs and URLs keep their own LTR run inside an Arabic page.
direction.staysLabel: Stays LTR — code, paths, numbers, URLs
direction.mixedSample: The review lands on branch feat/rag-eval in omar/rag-service, 3 files changed, and the engineer replies within 48 hours.

components.title: Components
components.body: The design system's classes, mapped onto the component layer. The primary action is a 1px accent outline on transparent, never a fill. Interaction states are built in — hover is an accent tint, pressed is one step past the base, focus is a 2px accent ring.

spacing.title: Spacing and elevation
spacing.body: A 0.70× density scale — dense on purpose, and it holds on mobile. Radii are 8px by default. Elevation is an edge plus ambient darkness, never stacked shadows.

home.enginesTitle: The people who teach are the people who build
home.enginesBody: Deraya teaches AI to individuals and, with the same people, does the technical work. The teaching builds the credibility; the engineering work proves it.
home.learnBody: Courses, AI roadmaps, career tracks, job preparation, 1-on-1 sessions. Sold to individuals — students, career switchers, working developers.
home.buildBody: Consultations, code review, GitHub and repo building, AI and programming solutions. Sold to teams and to the learners' own employers.
home.tracksTitle: Each one ends with something that runs

home.proofTitle: A senior engineer reads your code and writes back.
home.proofBody: Not a testimonial — a review comment on a repository, anchored to the line it is about. The code stays in English and reads left to right; the comment is in whichever language the thread is in.
